##### Project general facts

All Seasons Residence is a contemporary residential development that combines elegant architecture with a modern lifestyle designed for comfort and convenience. Featuring a refined collection of studio, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, the project offers thoughtfully planned homes with spacious layouts, abundant natural light, and sophisticated interiors. Its sleek architectural design and premium finishes create a timeless living environment that perfectly balances style, functionality, and everyday comfort.

Residents enjoy a selection of lifestyle amenities designed to promote relaxation, recreation, and community living. Beautifully landscaped outdoor spaces, dedicated leisure and recreational areas, and inviting communal facilities provide the perfect setting for unwinding or spending quality time with family and friends. The development fosters a strong sense of community while offering excellent connectivity to Dubai's major destinations, business hubs, shopping centers, and entertainment venues, making it an ideal address for both homeowners and investors.

The residences are finished with high-quality contemporary materials that reflect modern elegance and lasting quality. Carefully selected finishes, practical layouts, and refined interior details create comfortable and sophisticated living spaces designed for modern lifestyles. Kitchens come fully equipped with integrated appliances, while the residences are delivered unfurnished, allowing homeowners the flexibility to personalize their interiors according to their own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Sports City is a dynamic and vibrant community in the heart of Dubai, offering a unique blend of sports, lifestyle, and leisure. Renowned for its world-class sports infrastructure, the district houses state-of-the-art facilities such as the Dubai International Cricket Stadium, the Els Club Golf Course, and academies for football, tennis, and swimming. These facilities cater to both professional athletes and sports enthusiasts, making it a sought-after destination for active lifestyles and sporting events.

Beyond sports, Dubai Sports City is a family-friendly neighborhood that combines modern living with convenience. It features a range of residential options, including apartments and villas, set amidst landscaped parks and green spaces. The community also includes schools, healthcare facilities, and retail outlets, ensuring that residents have everything they need within reach. Its pedestrian-friendly design encourages outdoor activities, with jogging tracks, play areas, and serene lakes adding to its charm.

The location of Dubai Sports City provides excellent connectivity to major areas of Dubai, including Dubai Marina, Downtown Dubai, and the Expo City area. This accessibility, combined with its vibrant atmosphere and focus on wellness, makes it a desirable place to live, work, and play. Whether you're a sports lover, a family seeking a peaceful environment, or a professional looking for convenient urban living, Dubai Sports City offers a balanced lifestyle tailored to diverse needs.
